note: Pinned vendor source for the ROCm backend. ROCm 10.1 is the only verified toolchain (userland, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1); 6.4 (early probe) and 7.7 (original target) are historical.

primary.comment: T3388 M=4 dp4a-class decode port (opt-in MLX_ROCM_M4DP4A, default off; default dispatch byte-identical). Integer-exact int8 dot on the integer ALU (v_mad_i32_i24 chain; the reference v_dot4c is gfx1036-only), LDS double-buffered Q8_1 staging, 4B global loads, in-order K lanes. CPU validation vs true GEMM 100% bf16-identical. The wheel builds from the fetched pinned tree (the repo root is the buildable `pip wheel .` source with the ROCm backend grafted in); the pin must resolve in the fork and `scripts/build-wheel.sh` fails loud otherwise. The committed vendor/mlx-rocm-upstream/ tree is a byte-verified PARTIAL reference snapshot — NOT the build input. GDN tail fusion + graph-decode diagnostics on the decode path; launcher pointer fix (host Data* -> gpu_ptr<T>) for the deterministic HSA memory fault. Gates G1/G2 pass (maxdiff 0.0). See docs/quickstart.md.

build.comment: RX 9070 XT is gfx1201 (RDNA4), NOT gfx110x. ROCm 10.1 userland (amdrocm-*-dev10.1, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1) provides hip/rocblas/rocprim/hiprand/hiprtc/hipblaslt/rocwmma; pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/rocm/core-10.1 (see docs/quickstart.md).
